description: This file defines the 'dm_radio_t' class, which encapsulates radio information and related operations in a wireless networking context. It includes methods for initialization, information retrieval, JSON encoding/decoding, comparison, parsing, and dumping radio info, along with constructors and destructor.

classes.name: dm_radio_t
classes.description: Represents radio information and operations for a wireless radio interface, including initialization, JSON encoding/decoding, comparison, parsing, and dumping of radio details.

methods.name: int init()
methods.description: Initializes the radio information structure to zero.

methods.name: em_radio_info_t * get_radio_info()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal 'em_radio_info_t' structure representing radio info.

methods.name: em_interface_t * get_radio_interface()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the radio interface structure within the radio info.

methods.name: unsigned char * get_radio_interface_mac()
methods.description: Returns the MAC address associated with the radio interface.

methods.name: char * get_radio_interface_name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the radio interface.

methods.name: unsigned char * get_radio_id()
methods.description: Returns the MAC address as the radio ID.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object to populate radio information, associating it with a parent ID.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the radio information into a JSON object for reporting or transmission.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Returns the orchestrator type for a radio.

methods.name: parse_radio_id_from_key
methods.description: Extracts the radio ID from a key string.

methods.name: dump_radio_info
methods.description: Displays the current radio information for debugging.

methods.name: dm_radio_t (constructor with em_radio_info_t*)
methods.description: Constructs a 'dm_radio_t' object with specified radio info.

methods.name: dm_radio_t (copy constructor)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an existing 'dm_radio_t' object.

methods.name: ~dm_radio_t
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources used by the object.
